findings.current: The vanguard of the Murim allied forces was heading straight for them.
findings.defect: Reverses the direction of the attack. The monsters are rushing toward the vanguard, not the vanguard toward the monsters.
findings.rationale: The preceding sentence identifies the approaching answers as the monstrous threat; this fragment names its target.
findings.replacement: Straight toward the Murim allied forces’ vanguard. Straight toward where they stood.
findings.source: 무림 연합군의 선봉, 바로 이곳을 향해서.

findings.current: The frightened horses whinnied and tossed their heads.
findings.defect: Changes the horses’ action from forceful snorting to whinnying and head-tossing.
findings.rationale: 투레질 refers to snorting or blowing air through the nose.

findings.current: His younger brother, who’d changed everything overnight—and then gone on to change everything around him.
findings.defect: Makes Taekyung the agent of the first overnight change. The source says everything changed for him before he changed his surroundings.
findings.rationale: 모든 것이 달라진 describes the change Taekyung experienced; 뒤바꾼 describes the change he subsequently caused.
findings.replacement: His younger brother, whose whole life had changed overnight—and who had then changed everything around him.
findings.source: 하루아침에 모든 것이 달라진, 그리고 이내 주위의 모든 것을 뒤바꾼 자신의 아우를.

findings.current: the Sect Leaders of the Nine Sects and One Gang and the Five Great Families plunged down like meteors, led by four of the Ten Kings.
findings.defect: Calls the leaders of the Five Great Families Sect Leaders, incorrectly assigning them a sect hierarchy.
findings.rationale: The Five Great Families are families, not sects; the English must not give their heads sect titles.
findings.replacement: the leaders of the Nine Sects and One Gang and the heads of the Five Great Families plunged down like meteors, led by four of the Ten Kings.
findings.source: 네 명의 십왕(十王)을 필두로 한 구파일방과 오대세가의 장문인들이

findings.defect: Drops the extra deference in 형님, which gives Wikyung a specific form of address to tease Mukyung about.
findings.rationale: 형님 is more deferential than 형; the distinction matters because the address itself is the subject of their exchange.
findings.replacement: “I thought you called me ‘hyungnim’ a moment ago.”

summary: The draft reverses who is approaching the vanguard, changes a key description of Jin Taekyung, and misrenders two physical and hierarchical details.
